Opening Reception //
Saturday, June 20th, 2026 // 6:00pm – 11:45pm

Closing Reception //
Saturday, June 27th, 2026 // 12:00pm – 8:00pm

Odelot // 151 South Saint Clair, Toledo, OH

About the Show // 
David Picciuto, known for his YouTube channel Make Something, presents his first solo exhibition, UNSUBSCRIBE. The show features wall work and mixed-media sculpture that mark a deliberate departure from the content that built his audience of nearly one million subscribers. No algorithms. No trend chasing. Just the work.

Artist Statement //

title: I don't know if I'm an artist
